claim: Agreement defines Consolidated Leverage Ratio as Consolidated Funded Debt at the last day of a Measurement Period divided by Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA for that Measurement Period.

source_spans.anchor_text: “ Consolidated Leverage Ratio ” means, as of the last day of any Measurement Period, the ratio of Consolidated Funded Debt at such date to Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA for such Measurement Period
